target.definition: Total value of Mexico's merchandise exports (original, not seasonally adjusted) during September 2026, as first published in INEGI's timely trade balance bulletin.

inputs.name: annual_exports_2025
inputs.description: Mexico's total merchandise exports in calendar year 2025

provenance.rationale: Mexico exported roughly USD 590-620bn in recent years; 2025 assumed near that level

inputs.name: annual_growth_factor
inputs.description: Year-over-year growth factor for Mexico's merchandise exports from 2025 to 2026

provenance.rationale: Near-flat trade growth with tariff uncertainty; modest upside/downside

inputs.name: september_share_of_year
inputs.description: Share of annual merchandise exports falling in September

provenance.rationale: September is a normal-length month; monthly share averages ~1/12 with seasonal variation

inputs.name: september_2025_exports
inputs.description: Mexico's merchandise exports in September 2025 (original figures)

provenance.rationale: Monthly exports have run around USD 50-55bn in recent years

inputs.name: september_yoy_factor
inputs.description: Year-over-year growth factor for September exports, 2025 to 2026

provenance.rationale: Similar to annual trend; monthly noise wider

inputs.name: daily_export_value
inputs.description: Average daily merchandise export value in 2026

inputs.name: september_activity_factor
inputs.description: Factor for September's daily export intensity relative to the annual average day

provenance.rationale: No strong seasonal tilt in September; allow modest deviation

inputs.name: us_imports_from_mexico_annual
inputs.description: US goods imports from Mexico in 2025 (proxy for Mexico's exports to its main partner)

provenance.rationale: US Census data show imports from Mexico around USD 500bn

inputs.name: us_share_of_mexico_exports
inputs.description: Share of Mexico's merchandise exports going to the United States

provenance.rationale: US accounts for roughly 80% of Mexican exports

inputs.name: september_share_of_us_annual
inputs.description: Share of annual US imports from Mexico arriving in September

provenance.rationale: Roughly uniform monthly distribution with seasonal noise

inputs.name: us_yoy_factor
inputs.description: Year-over-year growth factor for US imports from Mexico, 2025 to 2026

paths.description: Allocate 2026 annual exports down to September
Scale US imports from Mexico to total Mexican exports and to September
